BUSINESS_RULES.TITLE: Business rules (guardrails)
BUSINESS_RULES.DESCRIPTION: Conditions that must be met before a conversation can change status. Only the attributes you select are required — never the full attribute list.
BUSINESS_RULES.FORM_HELP: Configure optional filter conditions (When), then the blocking effect (Then). Only selected attributes or categories are required.
BUSINESS_RULES.PRESETS_HELP: One click adds a ready-made rule. Edit it to choose which fields and conditions apply.
BUSINESS_RULES.EMPTY: No guardrails yet. Create a custom rule or activate a preset.
BUSINESS_RULES.LEGACY_BANNER: This account still has legacy conversation required attributes. Prefer business rules below; both are enforced on resolve until you migrate.

FIELDS.NAME: Name
FIELDS.NAME_PLACEHOLDER: e.g. Require sale total on resolve
FIELDS.ATTRIBUTES_HELP: Mark a category to require all of its fields (including future ones), or pick individual fields.
FIELDS.CONDITIONS_HELP: Optional. Same filters as Automations. Empty = always apply the effect on the target status.
FIELDS.LABEL: Forbidden label

TYPE_HELP.require_attributes_on_status: Require selected conversation and/or contact fields when changing to the target status. On resolve, a modal asks for any missing values. Number/currency/percent values of 0 count as empty.
TYPE_HELP.if_attribute_then_require: Only when the When conditions match. Then require extra conversation and/or contact fields. On resolve, the same modal collects missing values. 0 is treated as empty for numeric fields.
TYPE_HELP.require_reason_on_status: When moving to pending/snoozed, require a recent private note and/or a conversation reason attribute.
TYPE_HELP.forbid_status_if: Block the status change if the conversation has the given label.
TYPE_HELP.require_assignee_on_status: Block the status change unless a team or human agent is assigned. An inbox bot does not count.

PRESETS.REQUIRE_ON_RESOLVE_DESC: Agents must fill selected attributes before resolving.
PRESETS.IF_X_REQUIRE_YZ_DESC: When filter conditions match, require additional fields on resolve.
PRESETS.MOTIVO_POSPONER_DESC: Require a private note or reason attribute when pending/snoozed.
PRESETS.FORBID_RESOLVE_LABEL_DESC: Block resolve when a conversation has a given label.
PRESETS.REQUIRE_ASSIGNEE_ON_OPEN_DESC: Opening requires a team or human agent (inbox bot does not count).
PRESETS.POST_COMPRA_DESC: After N days from a date attribute, run actions (label, message, etc.).
PRESETS.FOLLOWUP_24H_DESC: If the last agent message is older than 24h with no customer reply, send a nudge.
PRESETS.SEGUIMIENTO_30D_DESC: When fecha_seguimiento is 30+ days old (open conversations), send a nudge, update the date, and notify the assignee.

STATUS_ERRORS.missing_private_note: Add a private note before changing status
STATUS_ERRORS.forbidden_label: Cannot change status while label “{label}” is present
STATUS_ERRORS.missing_assignee: Assign a team or agent before changing status
STATUS_ERRORS.generic: Business rule blocked this status change

MODAL.PRIVATE_NOTE_HINT: Add a private note in the conversation, then try again.

BUSINESS_RULES.ENABLED_WARNING: Enabled rules can block Resolve/Snooze/Open until required fields are filled. Test with Dry run before turning rules on.

PAUSE.LABEL: Pause all business rules
PAUSE.HELP: Escape hatch: agents can change status without guardrails until you turn this off.

DRY_RUN.TITLE: Dry-run business rules
DRY_RUN.HELP: Preview which fields would be required for a status change with sample attributes. Does not save or change chats.

LINT.IMPOSSIBLE_AND: Impossible AND on the same attribute (use OR for alternate values).
LINT.EMPTY_REQUIRE_SET: Enabled rule requires no fields (empty keys/categories).
LINT.MISSING_TRIGGER: If-then rule needs conditions or a when-attribute.
LINT.FORBID_CONFLICTS_REQUIRE: Forbid status "{status}" conflicts with another require rule ({other_rule_name}).
